images.seen: 32 states, all small Neolithic culture shapes in plausible places; Cliopatria has no shapes this early, so nothing to compare; first-year Cucuteni-Trypillia, Atlantic megalith builders and Linear Pottery changes look as the ledgers say.

Europe: Linear Pottery, Lengyel, Vinca, Cucuteni-Trypillia and Atlantic megalith shapes (Brittany, Poitou, Alentejo) match their keyframes; no state far from its region; Lengyel has small interior holes and Linear Pottery keeps a few specks on the Hungarian plain (both explained under issues).
identical to -4800 (a quiet window: one year with changes); Cliopatria empty; no jumps, no missing or late-drawn state.

Ubaid period drawn as one body from the Amuq and Jazira down the Tigris and Euphrates to the Gulf coast, with the former Samarra land inside it from -4800 as the ledger says; Pottery Neolithic Levant separate on the coast.
zoom on Lengyel and Linear Pottery: Lengyel has about seven small interior holes and Linear Pottery leaves three specks on the Hungarian plain (about 10 cells in Hungary).

issues.what: Keyframe snap: ubaid-period_-4800 (adjust) is 53 cells narrower than the ledger result (Gaziantep 18, K. Maras 12, Aleppo 8, +4 more, the north-west edge of the northern Ubaid). The ledger's -5100 gain 'northern Mesopotamia and the Amuq' is a wider region than the keyframe's 'Jazira, Assyria and the Amuq'. The keyframe note says outlying Ubaid find spots (Mersin, Norsuntepe, Arslantepe) are deliberately not drawn. Below the 200-cell threshold and not clearly wrong, so the compiler's keyframe snap stands.

Lengyel culture shows about seven small holes inside its body in Transdanubia and Slovakia. They come from the dossier's own region spec, a union of admin-1 units: the resolved spec (540 cells) equals the owned cells exactly, so the holes are cells outside the listed units, not a compiler fault. The shape runs from -5000 to -4501 across four windows, so a keyframe override here would collide with the neighbours. I did not identify which land the holes are (lakes or unlisted units) and left it.

Linear Pottery culture keeps about 10 cells in Hungary after its Alföld group ended in -4940 (6 in Pest county, which neither the Alföld loss in ledger/7 nor the Lengyel spec lists). Three tiny specks on the Hungarian plain, 0.4 percent of the state. Not worth a patch: a loss event of that size would sit inside the snap tolerance and the -4800 keyframe would put the cells back, and a keyframe override would span -4800 to -4501.

Packet flags: 0 size-rule conflicts, 0 skipped or unresolved events, 0 relations, 0 contests, 0 close-colour neighbour pairs. The one busy year, -4800 (1382 cells: Cucuteni-Trypillia 623, Linear Pottery loss 315, Atlantic megalith 185), is the founding of two states and the Linear Pottery loss of the Dniester lands; the result matches the dossier keyframes.
